CVE-2025-29903: False positive. kotlin-android-extensions-runtime-1.9.22.jar and kotlin-parcelize-runtime-1.9.22.jar are build-time transitive artifacts pulled in by AGP. They are NOT shipped in the APK and do not run on end-user devices. CVE-2025-29903 affects the Kotlin IDE plugin, not Android runtime libraries. OWASP incorrectly matches the "1.9.22" version string to the Kotlin CPE. Project Kotlin version is 2.0.21 (unaffected).

CVE-2023-2976: Guava Files.createTempDir() world-readable temp dir on UNIX. Not applicable to Android: Android sandbox prevents cross-app file access regardless of POSIX permissions, and Firebase/this app do not call createTempDir(). Transitive runtime dependency pulled in by Firebase SDK (firebase-common).
CVE-2020-8908: Guava temp dir vulnerability (CVSS 3.3 — below threshold). Suppressed for report hygiene. Same root cause as CVE-2023-2976; not applicable on Android. Transitive dep of Firebase SDK.

False positive: play-services-measurement-api (firebase-analytics transitive dep). OWASP CPE matching incorrectly associates this Google Play Services AAR with CVEs for unrelated products. Runs inside Android app sandbox — no server-side exposure.

CVE-2020-8913: False positive. Split APK install privilege escalation in Google Play Services PROCESS. Affects the Android OS Play Services process, NOT the play-services-base/basement/tasks library JARs bundled in this app. These are client-side SDK libraries; they don't perform Split APK installation.

CVE-2022-20503: False positive. Play Services satellite radio permission check. Affects the Android OS Play Services system process, NOT the app-bundled SDK libs. play-services-base/basement are client libraries that do not manage system features.
CVE-2022-20006: False positive. Play Services Android OS vulnerability. Affects the Android OS Play Services system process, NOT the app-bundled SDK libs.

False positive: firebase-encoders-json / firebase-encoders-proto. Firebase-internal serialization helpers with no known CVEs. Suppressed via purl to prevent OWASP CPE mis-matching against json/protobuf products.
False positive: firebase-datatransport. Crash-report batching library with no known CVEs. Suppressed via purl to prevent OWASP version/name mis-matching.
False positive: firebase-installations / firebase-installations-interop. Firebase Installation ID libraries with no known CVEs. Suppressed via purl to prevent OWASP version/name mis-matching.
False positive / build-time only: google-services Gradle plugin 4.4.2. Plugin and its transitive deps run only during the Gradle build. NOT in the APK. CVEs in build tools do not affect end users.

CVE-2021-22573: google-auth-library-oauth2-http token-exchange vulnerability. Build-time transitive dep of firebase-crashlytics Gradle plugin. NOT shipped in the APK; not a runtime vulnerability for end users. Mapping-file upload disabled in debug builds.
False positive / build-time only: firebase-crashlytics-gradle plugin. Build tool not shipped in the APK. Any CVE match is a build-tool false positive.
False positive / build-time only: firebase-crashlytics-buildtools. Build-time bytecode transformation tool not shipped in the APK.

CVE-2023-33953: gRPC server DoS via message batching (CVSS 7.5). Any gRPC library here is a build-time transitive dependency (via Crashlytics Gradle plugin or Kotlin/Gradle tooling). The Android app does not run a gRPC server; this client-side Android build tool is not affected.
CVE-2023-32732: gRPC DoS (CVSS 5.3 — below threshold). Suppressed for report hygiene. Build-time transitive dep; app is gRPC client only.
